results.question: Who is the customer with the highest number of orders?

results.question: What is the best selling product?
results.generated_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(od.quantity * od.unit_price * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_sales FROM order_details od JOIN products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1
results.expected_sql: SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_details GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Find categories with average product price above 30.

results.question: Which employee generated the highest sales?
results.generated_sql: SELECT e.last_name, e.first_name, SUM(od.total_order_value) AS total_sales FROM orders o JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount)) AS total_order_value FROM order_details GROUP BY order_id) od ON o.order_id = od.order_id JOIN employees e ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_id ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1
results.expected_sql: SELECT employees.employee_id, SUM(order_details.unit_price * order_details.quantity) AS sales FROM employees JOIN orders ON employees.employee_id = orders.employee_id JOIN order_details ON orders.order_id = order_details.order_id GROUP BY employees.employee_id ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 1
